summary.text: Colin Wellenkamp is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 105 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. An adjunct professor and environmental lawyer by training, he previously led the Mississippi River Cities & Towns Initiative.

paragraphs.text: Wellenkamp was born in Kirkwood, Missouri, and graduated from Chaminade College Preparatory School in 1995.

He earned a bachelor's degree in environmental studies from Saint Louis University in 1999, a law degree in environmental law from the Creighton University School of Law in 2003, and a graduate degree in sustainable development law from George Washington Law School in 2011.
His career experience includes working as an adjunct professor, an environmental scientist, and the executive director of the Mississippi River Cities & Towns Initiative.
Wellenkamp defeated Ron Odenthal in the November 2024 general election for the District 105 seat and took office on January 8, 2025.
For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee, the Local Government Committee and the Joint Committee on the Life Sciences.
